briefdescription.para: Return true if computeDependence can process MI.

detaileddescription.para: Return true if A and B do not have any dependences between them, and can be re-ordered without changing program semantics.

briefdescription.para: Compute a result for the following question: can MI be re-ordered from after Insts to before it.

detaileddescription.para: canHandle should return true for all instructions in Insts.

briefdescription.para: Analyze MBB to check if its terminating branch can be turned into an implicit null check.

detaileddescription.para: If yes, append a description of the said null check to NullCheckList and return true, else return false.

briefdescription.para: Wrap a machine instruction, MI, into a FAULTING machine instruction.

detaileddescription.para: The FAULTING instruction does the same load/store as MI (defining the same register), and branches to HandlerMBB if the mem access faults. The FAULTING instruction is inserted at the end of MBB.

briefdescription.para: Rewrite the null checks in NullCheckList into implicit null checks.

Returns AR_NoAlias if MI memory operation does not alias with PrevMI, AR_MayAlias if they may alias and AR_WillAliasEverything if they may alias and any further memory operation may alias with PrevMI.

memberdef.argsstring: (const MachineInstr &MI, unsigned PointerReg, ArrayRef< MachineInstr * > PrevInsts)
memberdef.name: isSuitableMemoryOp

briefdescription.para: Return SR_Suitable if MI a memory operation that can be used to implicitly null check the value in PointerReg, SR_Unsuitable if MI cannot be used to null check and SR_Impossible if there is no sense to continue lookup due to any other instruction will not be able to be used.

detaileddescription.para: PrevInsts is the set of instruction seen since the explicit null check on PointerReg.

briefdescription.para: Returns true if DependenceMI can clobber the liveIns in NullSucc block if it was hoisted to the NullCheck block.

detaileddescription.para: This is used by caller canHoistInst to decide if DependenceMI can be hoisted safely.

briefdescription.para: Return true if FaultingMI can be hoisted from after the instructions in InstsSeenSoFar to before them.

detaileddescription.para: Set Dependence to a non-null value if we also need to (and legally can) hoist a dependency.

briefdescription.para: runOnMachineFunction - This method must be overloaded to perform the desired machine code transformation or analysis.
getAnalysisUsage - This function should be overriden by passes that need analysis information to do their job.

detaileddescription.para: If a pass specifies that it uses a particular analysis result to this function, it can then use the getAnalysis<AnalysisType>() function, below.
